MIND. [1] [Gamb.]
Irritable mood.
Cheerful, talkative, feeling of ease, great lightness of all his motions.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Gamb.]
Vertigo during rest or motion ; morning when rising.
Heaviness in whole head, with dulness, sleepiness and pain in back.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Gamb.]
Violent burning of eyes and photophobia, evening or afternoon, > from walking in open air, but returning in morning.
Violent itching of eyes in evening.
Itching of inner canthi, with discharge of acrid, corrosive tears after rubbing ; > in open air.
Nightly agglutination of lids, burning in morning, photophobia through day, and frequent stitching pain in eyes.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Gamb.]
Ringing in left ear all the time ; sometimes hissing.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Gamb.]
Violent chronic sneezing in daytime only ; feeling of coldness in points of incisor teeth ; extremely painful burning in region of liver.
Dryness of right nostril.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Gamb.]
Tearing in all the right molars.
Sensation of coldness at edge of incisors.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Gamb.]
Bitter taste in mouth.
Burning of tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Gamb.]
Dryness of mouth ; clammy, adhesive state of mouth.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Gamb.]
Pain as from soreness in throat.
Sore pain in throat, which is felt when even touching outer side of neck.
Rawness and burning in throat, constant hawking.
Violent stitches in right side of throat.
Stinging in right side of throat during and between acts of deglutition.
The throat feels swollen.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Gamb.]
Frequent violent empty eructations.
Nausea from stomach, when walking in open air.
Nausea, inclination to vomit, accumulation of saliva in mouth ; gulping up of sour water.
Frightful vomiting and purging, with fainting.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Gamb.]
Empty feeling in stomach and abdomen.
Gnawing in stomach.
Constant sore pain in stomach.
Ulcerative pain in stomach, passing off after eating.
Acute stitches in stomach.
Dartings in stomach, causing one to start.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Gamb.]
Burning in region of liver.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Gamb.]
Pinching in abdomen immediately after eating.
Frequent severe pinching in entire abdomen without urging, or, with diarrhœa and burning in anus, with relief of pain.
Gnawing in a small spot below umbilicus.
Rumbling and rolling in bowels.
Gurgling in abdomen, as of fluid running from a bottle.
Rushing sounds in abdomen as from motions of air and fluid feces, as occurs before diarrheic stools.
Inflation and tension of abdomen, with pinching in umbilical region.
Ileo-cecal region painful and sensitive to pressure.
In groins sticking, tension ; pinching.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Gamb.]
Profuse discharge of flatus, especially evening and night.
Yellow and green diarrheic stool, mixed with mucus, preceded by excessive cutting around umbilicus.
Profuse watery diarrhœa, with colic and tenesmus.
Stool expelled all at once, with a single, somewhat prolonged effort.
Stools of dark green mucus, offensive, corrosive.
Stools very fetid, and come away with a gush all at once ; or mucus and blood, with great tenesmus.
Fecal diarrhœa, stools evacuated with great force.
Great relief after stool as though an irritating substance were removed from bowels.
Diarrhœa : < forenoon, or during day ; after drinking ale ; > from pressing abdomen (cutting pains).
Profuse yellow watery diarrhœa in hot weather, particularly old people.
Acute and chronic diarrhœa ; infantile diarrhœa ; dysentery.
Summer complaint.
Bloody stools in dysentery.
Lienteric stools.
Diarrhœa, with burning pain and tenesmus of rectum protrusion of anus and constant pinching around umbilicus, sometimes with mucous stools.
Burning in anus after stool ; anus sore and excoriated.
Hard, insufficient stool, with strong urging, pressing and protrusion of rectum.
Hard stool, succeeded by burning at anus.
Thin, watery, yellow stool, coming out all at once ; < morning and forenoon ; before and during stool some pain and urging ; after stool great relief. θ Diarrhœa.
Stools copious, watery, yellow, or like curdled milk, of offensive, sickening smell, expelled with much force ; vomits food undigested. θ Diarrhœa during hot weather.
Soon after eating irresistible desire to evacuate bowels, which continued as long as there was anything to pass ; after these passages great pain in lower bowels, lasting an hour ; emaciation ; prostration ; stools consist of yellow mucus and undigested food. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
Chronic diarrhœa consequent upon exposure ; evacuations occur principally at night, if they occur earlier they are preceded by colicky pains and much rumbling in abdomen ; finds relief only after four or five passages ; stools are of a chocolate-brown color, containing lumps of mucus, often streaked with blood or mixed with undigested food ; great lassitude.
Constant urging to stool with colicky pains ; abdomen distended with flatus, and very painful and sensitive to pressure, particularly in ileo-cecal region ; food passes undigested, diarrhœa watery and often mucous ; fever towards evening ; night sweats ; anorexia ; great thirst ; mind much depressed ; twelve to fifteen stools occur daily. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
Painful, muco-serous, odorless diarrhœa ; evacuations occur every hour, preceded and followed by severe pains, causing him to draw up limbs and cry out ; tenesmus during each stool causes rectum to protrude about one inch, which, however, returns again in ten or fifteen minutes, after which he is free of pain for about twenty minutes and can sleep ; face pale, showing evidences of suffering ; skin cool ; meteorism ; hypogastrium sensitive to pressure ; during attack limbs are cool and covered with cold sweat, face red, head hot. θ Diarrhœa.
Diarrhœa coming on at night ; stools mixed with lumps of mucus and blood.
Watery, greenish stools mixed with mucus ; griping before forcible and profuse stool. θ Cholera infantum.
Lienteria for a month ; emaciated almost to a skeleton ; bowels seemed to hold nothing ; stools very fetid, and come away with a gush, nearly all of stool at a time ; often gurgling sounds are heard as if water were passing through a bunghole.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Gamb.]
Stitches in left kidney.
Emission of a few drops of urine at a time, then intermitting, and finally returning, with burning at orifice.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Gamb.]
Menses too early and too profuse ; long lasting.
Leucorrhœa.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Gamb.]
Pressure in middle of chest.
Stitches going from both sides of chest towards each other.
Pain in chest as if it were all raw.
Sensation of soreness in every part of chest.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Gamb.]
Weight on chest, causing sleeplessness.
Repeated extremely painful stitches in sternum.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Gamb.]
Pain in small of back, as if bruised or as if sprained.
Repeated gnawing in coccyx. θ Coccyodynia.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Gamb.]
Pain in shoulders ; tearing.
Stitch on top of right shoulder.
Stitching pains in upper limbs, come on or are < in evening.
Stinging and numb feeling in ball of right thumb.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Gamb.]
Cramp in calf, with contraction of toes.
Heaviness and languor of feet.
   

NERVES. [36] [Gamb.]
Much lassitude and debility ; emaciation.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Gamb.]
Sleepiness, great inclination to sleep.
Sleep broken by anxious dreams.
Anxious, vexatious dreams.
   

TIME. [38] [Gamb.]
The conditions are especially apt to occur toward evening or at night.
   

FEVER. [40] [Gamb.]
Violent chill, beginning in back.
Violent shaking at 7 P. M., beginning in back, with external coldness of whole body, continues till 4 A. M.
Increased heat with anxiety, flushes and perspiration.
Heat always slight, often wanting. θ Intermittent fever.
Night-sweat all over.
Paroxysm 7 P. M. ; evening 6 to 8 P. M., lasting all night.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Gamb.]
Profuse watery diarrhœa, particularly with old people.
   

SKIN. [46] [Gamb.]
Violent itching on various parts of body ; burning after scratching, < evenings and nights.
Biting like from ants over whole body < evening and night.
Itching blisters on both hands, first pale, then red.
